releaseNotes:
- Made the Blur Tool dynamic (Glass panes effect) for smoother real-time obfuscation
- Fixed an issue where text annotations in the active selection state were missing from the final copied image
- Fixed severe anti-aliasing issues where drawn shapes (Lines, Paths) had jagged edges and chopped end-caps
- Added a new 'What's New' popup window to automatically show release notes after Snippy updates
- Added a new setting to toggle the automatic 'What's New' popup window
- Added a 'Release Notes' button in the system tray menu for on-demand access
- Optimized background memory trimming for more efficient idle RAM usage
